_comment: Merge this object's `mcpServers` entry into ~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json. The signal-mcp container must be running (`docker compose up -d` from ~/Repos/signal-mcp). Claude Desktop spawns the MCP server stdio process inside the running container per session. The `sg docker -c "exec docker exec ..."` wrapper is required on Linux because Claude Desktop sessions started before jwowk was added to the `docker` group don't have it as a supplementary group; `sg` runs the command under that group. The `exec` inside the -c string replaces the spawned bash with docker exec so SIGTERM propagates cleanly to the MCP server when Claude Desktop closes the connection.
